lines.text: Priya's friend asked about the best hike of her fall.
Golden trees, a waterfall, an easy loop.
But Priya couldn't remember the trail name, the distance, or where she parked.
Here's the fix. Take two minutes at the car after every hike.
Write the date, the trail, the miles, the time it took, the weather, and one thing to pack next time.
By the end of the year, you have your own guidebook.
Save this before your next hike.
